name: Tiny Dungeon ~BRAVE or SLAVE~
source: Final Game for The Tiny Dungeon Series, In the last game Shirasagi Hime, our protagonist was left with a miraculous decision. Now, it is time to let all the dreams and hopes be answered in the Final Stage.
translation: 《Tiny Dungeon》系列最终作。在上一部作品中，主人公白鹭姬面临了一个宛如奇迹般的抉择。如今，所有梦想与希望都将在最终舞台迎来答案。
